newsitem.title: USA: Muni yield curve steepens over past week - Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Muni yield curve steepens over past week - Delphis.

text.p: The municipal yield curve steepened over the week ended Thursday, as one-year maturities lost five basis points and 30-years gained between five and 10 basis points, Delphis Hanover Corp said on Friday.
Long-term muni price erosion matched losses in the Treasury market, where the long bond yield rose five basis points for the week to finish Thursday at 6.85 percent.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields were also five basis points higher, moving to 5.65 percent. Thirty-year Baa yields gained 10 basis points to 6.50 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated and Baa-rated muni yields were both unchanged for the third consecutive week, holding at 4.95 percent and 5.75 percent, respectively.

Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds fell five basis points across the credit spectrum, reversing the prior week's move. One-year Aaa-rated munis fell to 3.70 percent and Baa's moved five lower to 4.50 percent.
The Aaa municipal yield curve steepened 10 basis points to 195, while the spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's steepened 15 basis points to 200 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years was unchanged for the fourth consecutive week at 80 basis points. The 30-year spread widened five basis points to 85 basis points.
